name: ue-dof-fix-1.0.1
body:
Universal UE DOF Fix for UE 5.0-5.6

- Built using RenoDX framework
- Replaces affected DOF shaders
- Fixes stepping/tiling artifacts that impact NVIDIA GPUs in particular using the fix from UE 5.7

v1.0.1
- Added more permutations
